scoring_justification: Eps2 spectra scored by recomputing peak positions from the agent's CSV (T1); band properties scored by comparing reported widths/gaps to paper gold because raw band energies are not submitted (T0).

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported band widths, band gaps, and eps2 peak positions used as gold reference values for comparison.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from the paper text: Li2CO3 band I 0.22 eV, II 0.72 eV, V 4.0 eV, gap 4.4 eV; Na2CO3 band I 0.10 eV, II 0.33 eV, gap 2.6 eV. Eps2 peaks: Li2CO3 9.9/13.9 eV; Na2CO3 5.2 eV; K2CO3 5.7 eV; LiKCO3 7.2, 8.6, 9.8 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually transcribed from the paper's narrative and Fig. 3.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's published numeric results; used as reproduction gold per D4/D6.

outputs.description: Computed valence band widths and fundamental band gaps for Li₂CO₃ and Na₂CO₃. Tolerances allow for basis‑set and functional differences.
Imaginary part of the dielectric function ε₂(E) for all four compounds. Peak positions and relative intensities are compared to paper‑reported values.

output_contract.notes: The scoring of band properties compares the agent's computed values for Li₂CO₃ and Na₂CO₃ to the paper‑reported values with tolerances of 0.1 eV for widths and 0.3 eV for gaps. The dielectric function scoring extracts local maxima from the CSV and compares them to paper‑reported peaks (tolerance 0.5 eV), also checking relative intensity ordering. The agent may use any open‑source DFT engine and pseudopotential set; the results should be within these tolerances.

steps.description: Validate band widths and gaps against paper gold with tolerances and check trend Li2CO3 gap > Na2CO3 gap.
Extract peaks from eps2 spectra, match expected peak positions (0.5 eV tolerance), and check intensity ordering for Li2CO3.
